description: Read recent news editorial and image-slot lines

steps.name: news-editorial-lines
steps.script:
$f='C:\TTiTTulares\ttittulares-mobile-trigger.log'
$a=@(Get-Content $f -Tail 180 | Where-Object { $_ -match 'EDITORIAL|CHAT MESSAGE|LAUNCH|IMAGE GLOBAL SLOT WAIT' } | Select-Object -Last 12)
Write-Output ('TTRESULT:'+(@{state='ok';lines=@($a)}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 3))
